justification: The live API accepts and echoes repeat.type="none" for alert suppression windows -- recordings/thousandeyes/alert_suppression_window/7.0.98-t1785764488786, where the accepted create request and its response both carry "type": "none" -- but the published enum declares only day, week, month and custom. A closed Kiota enumeration makes the missing value unrepresentable in both directions: refused on write, silently dropped on read.
